text:
Far from my own branch,
poor delicate leaf,
where are you going? From the beech
where I was born, the wind tore me away.

It comes again and carries me
from forest to countryside,
from valley to mountain.

With it, forever,
I wander, and know nothing else.

I go where all things go,
where, by nature,
the rose leaf goes
and the laurel leaf.

translation.title: Canto XXXV: Imitation
